en.html:
She lies in bed, vacant eyes wide open.
She seems conscious. Of a will of her own, there is no sign.
en.text:
She lies in bed, vacant eyes wide open.
She seems conscious. Of a will of her own, there is no sign.

ja.html:
床に伏して、虚ろな瞳を見開いている。
　意識はあるようだが、意思を匂わすものはなかった。
